name: long-form-lengths-written-short
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): Decode accepts a long form with more bytes than needed (0x82 for the set, 0x81 for uid, 0x83 for 48, 0x81 inside 48); encode writes the short form for a length below 128, so the output is the plain round-trip message. Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program.
